title: ...and sharing
content: Turns out it's fun! I've led engineering teams as mentor at a technical academy, guiding new developers through building production-grade full-stack applications with TypeScript, React, Node.js, and PostgreSQL. Two-month agile cycles teaching architecture, best practices, team dynamics, the whole development process. Best outcome? Mentees landing professional engineering roles. And a bit of side work - teaching young kids the basics of programming through game development with Scratch, their absolute delight when they see their code come to life is priceless.
